{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp and chainstatemanager_opts.h to update kernel C-API and options for the new validation queue.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "refactor",
      "rationale": "Updates the libbitcoinkernel C-API and ChainstateManager options to accommodate asynchronous block validation. These updates are downstream adaptations to validation architecture rather than external driver improvements for kernel consumers."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Matched via validation.cpp; does not alter mempool data structures, limits, or policy rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to mempool."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/block_template_manager.cpp and src/node/miner.cpp mechanically to adjust to locking and chainstate interface changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to mining."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/net_processing.cpp and net message handling paths to decouple message processing from block activation.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.70,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Decouples block validation from the P2P message thread and removes cs_main requirements from peer block download tracking and compact block reconstruction. Benchmarks demonstrate a 98% reduction in PING/PONG latency (41.8 ms to 0.77 ms) and a 32–45% drop in block-serving latency during IBD."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/mining.cpp only to adapt to internal chainstate changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to rpc."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Unit and fuzz test additions specifically validate the new queue and peerman concurrency, belonging to validation and p2p rather than generic test frameworks.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to tests."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp only for startup and shutdown of the validation queue worker thread.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to utils."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces src/validation_queue.cpp and modifies src/validation.cpp to handle block persistence and chain activation asynchronously.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Introduces a dedicated single-worker validation queue in ChainstateManager to process admitted blocks asynchronously while keeping initial validation synchronous. The change reduces cs_main contention and yields an observed ~5% speedup in benchmarked IBD segments."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 2,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
